import re

def parse_expense_line(line):
    # Pattern: "Name paid $amount for "Description". Owed equally by Name1, Name2 and Name3."
    pattern = r'^(\w+) paid \$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?) for "([^"]+)"\. Owed equally by (.+)\.$'
    match = re.match(pattern, line.strip())
    if not match:
        return None
    payer = match.group(1)
    amount = float(match.group(2))
    description = match.group(3)
    owed_str = match.group(4)
    # Split by comma and "and"
    owed_str = owed_str.replace(' and ', ', ')
    debtors = [name.strip() for name in owed_str.split(',') if name.strip()]

    }
